This paper introduces MiniBert24, a lightweight, transformer-based architecture specifically designed for stock market movement prediction by leveraging news related to finance and past stock price information. The model is tailored for high computational efficiency, combining a reduced number of transformer layers with fewer attention heads while retaining strong predictive power. We utilize a unique dataset incorporating historical headlines from the Reddit WorldNews channel and Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) data, creating a binary classification task to forecast daily stock price movement. MiniBert24 obtains an excellent AUC of 96.7% and an F1-score of 96.43%, outperforming standard transformer models while reducing computational overhead. These results demonstrate the potential of MiniBert24 to serve as a robust tool for market prediction in real-time trading environments. The model’s ability to fuse textual data with stock market indicators provides a compelling solution for financial analysts and algorithmic traders seeking efficient, high-performing predictive models.

articleTitle: Development of a Low Cost IoT Integrated System in Precision Smart Garden
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: This study highlights the development of an embedded device based on Internet of Things intended for precision smart gardens, providing comprehensive method to monitor environmental parameters, as well as soil pH, nutrients, and lethal gas detection. The device includes a well-designed front-end section by NodeMCU microcontrollers. It has several high-precision sensors for checking temperature and humidity, detecting hazardous emissions of harmful gases, and monitoring of water level while raining. Additionally, NPK sensor and pH sensor have been integrated for monitoring soil nutrition and pH levels. The back end is fully connected with the Adafruit program, providing real-time view of sensor parameters via mobile and laptop, assisting in data visualization, and data analysis. Google spreadsheet serves as a dependable database support. Validity of sensor process has been carried out, describing that these measurements of our device are statistically consistent with those of commercially devices available in market. SPSS software is used to perform for getting paired sample t-test value more than 0.05 and correlation greater than 0.08 value to validate our sensors parameter with commercial devices. This research supports our device's usefulness and serves as a template for researchers in future to use theiradata correctly. Furthermore, complete data analysis via graphical representation of all parameters, serves thorough understanding of environmental traits and soil conditions.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Diagnosis Using a Hybrid Method of BoVW, LBP, and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Brain tumor is one of the most deadly diseases today. Early identification is the key in treatment and automated method of image classification can help in this process. But, there are significant obstacles in precisely identifying brain tumors and increasing the classification accuracy for different types of tumors. In order to address the problem, the work suggests a hybrid model for effectively detecting and classifying brain tumors. First, the obtained pictures are preprocessed with resizing, application of sharpening filter and final stage of contrast enhancement. Further preprocessing in carried out using the K-mean clustering algorithm Next, Feature extraction is done by using the BoVW together with LBP which deal with the overall and region-specific texture features respectively. Following that, the seven statistical features are extracted, and then they are utilized as input to the artificial neural network classifier in order to obtain the classification of the glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumor. The training function ‘Levenberg-Marquardt’ is also used in this work. This method provides 99.0 % of accuracy on Dataset I and 99.2% accuracy on Dataset II. Moreover, in relation to other modern methods, the selected seven statistical features employed in this study are relatively limited in demonstrating this performance.

articleTitle: Decentralized Solar PV/Battery-based Energy Management for Isolated Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: In remote/isolated areas, access to reliable electricity can drastically improve the quality of life, supporting essential services like healthcare, education, and local businesses. However, in regions where extending the power grid is impractical, off-grid solar photovoltaic (PV) systems with battery storage have emerged as a promising solution. This study presents an optimized energy management system for off-grid solar PV systems, specifically designed to address the challenges of fluctuating solar irradiance, varying load demands, and battery longevity in isolated applications. Integrating advanced Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithms ensures efficient energy capture and stable power delivery even under rapidly changing environmental conditions. The Battery Management System (BMS) employs a bidirectional DC-DC converter to precisely control charging and discharging cycles, contributing to extended battery lifespan and optimized energy flow. Through simulations in MATLAB, the proposed system demonstrates rapid DC bus voltage stabilization at approximately 400 V within 0.1 seconds after load variations, maintaining consistent power output. These results indicate that the optimized energy management approach enhances system efficiency and significantly improves reliability, making it a robust and sustainable solution for rural electrification in off-grid settings.

articleTitle: Enhancing Power Grid Reliability in Bangladesh: An IoT-Based Approach to Transmission Line Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: The rapid expansion of Bangladesh's power grid to meet growing energy demands necessitates an efficient and reliable approach to transmission line fault detection. This paper presents the design and implementation of an IoT-based transmission line fault detection system tailored specifically for Bangladesh's unique environmental and infrastructural challenges. By leveraging real-time data from a network of sensors monitoring current, temperature, and environmental conditions, the system enables immediate detection and response to unsymmetrical faults, significantly reducing the risk of prolonged power outages. The proposed system integrates GPS for precise fault location, GSM for alert notifications, and Wi-Fi for remote monitoring, creating a comprehensive solution that enhances grid reliability. Additionally, the system's prototype model demonstrates its practical applicability, offering a user-friendly interface for grid operators and proving its effectiveness through real-time monitoring and fault detection. This research contributes to the modernization of Bangladesh’s power infrastructure, aligning with the nation's goals of sustainable development and energy security by ensuring an uninterrupted and stable power supply.

articleTitle: Home Energy Optimization Strategies in Bangladesh to Minimize Electricity Cost and Grid Energy Consumption Using Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Due to rapid urbanization and increasing energy use, Bangladesh is facing challenges in ensuring a reliable electricity supply, therefore it makes sensible to use more renewable resources in order to meet the rising energy demand. This research develops an energy management system (EMS) with two different approaches based on the facilities of various types of consumers. One approach uses renewable energy resource (RER) and energy storage system (ESS) with block rate tariff. Based on the state of charge (SOC) of the ESS and the availability of solar energy, this optimization system schedules energy resources, decides when to use or turn off the grid. Then the optimization problem is resolved using Interior-Point method. Another approach is load scheduling based on time-of-use tariff without utilizing of ESS and RER, solved by applying Genetic Algorithm. All of these methods are simulated in MATLAB. The optimization results are compared with the real-time electricity bills to confirm validate the model. It is shown that the simulation result of block rate tariff model using RER and ESS is more effective which reduces electricity costs by 68.97% and usages of grid energy by 75.23% than the load scheduling model.

articleTitle: Epileptic Seizure Prediction Using a Deep Hybrid CNN-GAN Model on EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
abstract: Epileptic seizure detection from EEG signals is essential for the diagnosis and treatment of neurological conditions. However, this task is difficult because of the complex and fluctuating characteristics of EEG data. To overcome these difficulties, this research employs a specialized CNN-GAN hybrid model designed to improve seizure prediction by generating realistic synthetic data. This approach addresses class imbalance and enhances feature learning. The process begins with preprocessing EEG datasets to remove noise and artifacts. Data augmentation follows, expanding the dataset and reducing the risk of overfitting. Segmentation then isolates important features to boost prediction accuracy. Feature extraction is achieved using a custom CNN model, and classification is performed with a GAN model. The model demonstrates high accuracy, with results of 99.95% on the BONN Dataset, 98.93% on the CHB-MIT Dataset and 98.80% on the SWEC-ETHZ Dataset. Overall, the custom CNN-GAN hybrid model significantly improves the accuracy of predicting epileptic seizures from EEG signals across various datasets.
